title: Three Young Smiling Children in Yard, 1950 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming snapshot of three young children standing together on a grassy lawn in front of a brick house and dense bushes. The child on the left wears a patterned sweater vest and dark trousers, while the younger two wear classic dark overalls. Taken in May 1950, this deckle-edged photograph captures everyday suburban childhood in post-WWII America.
